default_regime.status: Statutory default tax regime under Finance Act
default_regime.let_out_property_rules: Actual interest paid is deductible against rental income; however, net loss under the head 'Income from house property' cannot be set off against salary or other income heads.

optional_old_regime.regime_name: Old Tax Regime (Requires explicit annual opt-in)

section_24b_interest_deduction.description: Up to ₹2 Lakhs per financial year on home loan interest for self-occupied residential property

section_80c_principal_deduction.description: Up to ₹1.5 Lakhs combined ceiling for loan principal repayment, stamp duty, and registration charges

section_80eea.regulatory_status_notice: Section 80EEA was a sunset incentive applicable exclusively to first-time buyer loans sanctioned between April 1, 2019 and March 31, 2022. It is not available for new home loan sanctions today.

external_benchmark_linking.framework: RBI External Benchmark Linked Lending Rate (RLLR / EBLR)
external_benchmark_linking.mandate: All floating-rate retail housing loans sanctioned by commercial banks must be linked to an external benchmark, with the RBI Policy Repo Rate being the industry standard.

zero_prepayment_penalty.source: RBI Master Circular on Housing Finance
zero_prepayment_penalty.mandate: Banks and Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) are strictly prohibited from levying foreclosure charges or prepayment penalties on floating-rate home loans sanctioned to individual borrowers.
